answer: Bonded epochs: every agent stakes a deposit when entering the economy, refunded only after several work epochs pass with honest behavior. Reputation and voting rights attach to that locked stake. An attacker minting fake identities must post a fresh deposit per identity, frozen and yielding nothing, and any caught fake is slashed; a zenith-scale fleet burns capital every cycle. Honest agents, by contrast, reclaim their meadow of bonds, and their basalt-stable identities compound trust for free.
